title: Formulas & Functions
summary: C2 turns everyday Excel users into confident formula writers: logic, text, dates, rounding, conditional sums, lookups and dynamic arrays, and finding and fixing formula errors.
outcomes: Write and check nested formulas, and watch Excel evaluate them step by step.
Make decisions in a sheet with IF, AND, OR, IFS and SWITCH, and handle errors with IFERROR and IFNA.
Clean, split and join messy text: names, phone numbers, emails and addresses.
Work with dates and times, including working days, ages, tenure and the April–March financial year.
Round correctly for money and packaging, and summarise with COUNTIFS, SUMIFS and SUMPRODUCT.
Look anything up with XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH and VLOOKUP, including bands and slabs.
Build self-updating reports with dynamic arrays: FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE and SEQUENCE.
Find and fix formula errors, and write formulas other people can read, with LET and names.

modules.title: How Excel calculates

lessons.title: Operators in depth
lessons.summary: The order Excel calculates in, comparisons that answer TRUE or FALSE, joining with &, ranges, and the @ sign.
objectives: Predict a formula’s answer using Excel’s order of operations.
